lines.briefing: These meters pay better than your badge!

lines.briefing: You look like you need premium care!

lines.briefing: Every light turns green for me!

lines.wrecked: Ow! The chairman needs a cushion!
lines.arrested: I still own the complaints department!

lines.briefing: These doughnuts aren't stopping for you!

lines.briefing: You're not on my drive-through menu!

lines.briefing: Free lunch? Read the tiny print!

lines.arrested: I'll print my own visiting pass!

lines.briefing: Thirty seconds or your chase is free!

lines.arrested: I'll run this pantry from my cell!

lines.briefing: Follow the jingle, miss the crime!

lines.briefing: That street's reserved for my table!

lines.briefing: My receipts are hotter than your engine!

lines.arrested: These cuffs won't cancel the service charge!

lines.briefing: Your pursuit gets zero stars!

lines.briefing: My maps don't show a police station!

lines.briefing: Wish you were fast enough, officer!

lines.arrested: I want royalties on that mugshot!

lines.briefing: Ready for another lap, officer?

lines.arrested: I'll put this jail in the gift shop!

lines.arrested: My cell's closed for maintenance!

lines.briefing: This trip costs more than your salary!

lines.arrested: I'll invoice you for this little trip!

lines.briefing: My compass points away from you!

lines.briefing: This whole city's my ticket machine!

lines.arrested: You can't navigate this city without me!

lines.briefing: You're late! Fine's already doubled!
lines.arrested: I'll bill you for time served!

lines.briefing: Twenty-six hours and still ahead of you!
lines.escaped: Put your defeat on my timesheet!
lines.wrecked: Ow! I need paid recovery leave!
lines.arrested: I'll put the guards on overtime!

lines.briefing: Need an extra hour to catch me?

lines.arrested: I'll make this sentence lose an hour!

lines.briefing: Your appointment with me just vanished!
lines.arrested: My lawyer has a priority booking!

lines.briefing: I decide what time you catch me!

lines.arrested: I'll reset every clock in this jail!

lines.briefing: Wake up! Your suspect's leaving!

lines.briefing: Hold please! Your road is closing!

lines.briefing: Catching me costs emergency rates!

lines.wrecked: Ow! Now I need urgent care!
lines.arrested: My appeal runs all night!

lines.briefing: Just a second! Actually, never mind!

lines.briefing: Your time is mine, officer!

lines.briefing: These ducks have places to be!

lines.briefing: My puddles! My rules!

lines.briefing: You're not allowed in my fast lane!

lines.arrested: These cuffs don't suit the VIP pool!

lines.briefing: Safety budget? Safely in my boot!
lines.arrested: I'll declare this arrest a safety hazard!

lines.briefing: Fog warning! Mostly for your judgment!
lines.arrested: I'll keep the whole cell block awake!

lines.briefing: No dock, no entry, no exceptions!
lines.arrested: I'll invoice this jail for docking!

lines.briefing: Champagne rescue! Ducks not included!
lines.wrecked: Ow! Where's the real rescue team?
lines.arrested: I'll upgrade this cell to first class!

lines.briefing: The winning duck rides with me!
lines.wrecked: Ow! Even the duck felt that!
lines.arrested: My duck and I demand a lawyer!

lines.briefing: Every duck in this race works for me!
lines.arrested: You haven't heard the last quack from me!
